name: SIRT (Simultaneous Iterative Reconstruction Technique)
definition: An iterative reconstruction method that normalizes ray residuals by total intersected length and backprojected updates by accumulated voxel sensitivity, enforcing nonnegativity.
summary: SIRT is an iterative CT reconstruction technique that updates all voxels simultaneously using normalized residuals, distinguishing it from ART by improving convergence stability in sparse-view scenarios.
